meta.title: Domi Adiwijaya — Portfolio
meta.description: Explore Domi Adiwijaya's portfolio, tech insights, and innovative projects by a professional Tech & HomeLab Enthusiast.

hero.blurb: I deliver dependable systems. From homelab architectures to production-grade automation, I translate complex constraints into elegant, resilient solutions.

about.lead: I’m driven to make technology meaningfully better, whether in a controlled homelab or by helping others resolve complex, real-world challenges.
about.p1: I’m Domi. A lifelong technologist, I’ve turned early curiosity into a disciplined practice of designing systems that solve consequential, real-world problems.
about.p2: My homelab operates as a focused R&D environment: I stress-test, break, and harden ideas, then productionize what proves robust.
about.p3: Beyond configuration and automation work, I codify and share what I learn so others can navigate complexity faster. That moment when everything clicks and just works is the target.

innovation.title: Tech Innovation

homelab.title: Homelab R&D

automation.title: Automation-First

sharing.title: Knowledge Sharing
sharing.description: I codify lessons into docs, demos, and talks, teaching to compound learning across teams.

skills.lead: The toolchain I rely on to design, automate, and operate systems that are elegant under load and predictable in failure.

tail.title: Never Stop Learning
tail.body: Technology evolves daily. I run continuous experiments to pressure-test new tools, refine my practice, and deliver measurably better outcomes.

services.lead: From full-stack infrastructure to that one stubborn task you want off your plate, I deliver pragmatic, durable solutions.

homelab.title: HomeLab Setup
homelab.description: Design and deploy a purpose-built homelab for learning, staging, or self-hosting, grounded in resilient networking, virtualization, and storage.

cloud.title: Cloud Migration
cloud.description: De-risk your move to the cloud with a pragmatic, cost-aware plan and a fit-for-purpose target architecture.

security.title: Security Setup
security.description: Establish pragmatic security controls that materially reduce risk without slowing delivery.

automation.title: Automation Magic
automation.description: Eliminate toil with robust, idempotent automation so you can focus on outcomes that matter.

monitoring.title: Monitoring & Alerts
monitoring.description: Gain actionable visibility and early signal across systems, well before users feel the impact.

data.title: Data & Backups
data.description: Protect critical data with resilient backups, rapid recovery, and disciplined lifecycle management.

tail.title: Need Something Different?
tail.body: Contexts vary and templates rarely fit. Tell me what you need, and we’ll design a solution that aligns with your goals, constraints, and timelines.

contact.lead: Have an initiative to scope or a problem space to unpack? Reach out, I’m keen to understand your objectives and outline a pragmatic path forward.
